prompt: I have coding standards in .claude/rules/code-quality.md. Add enforcement blocks to all 5 rules in the file: 'Use descriptive variable names', 'Functions should do one thing well', 'No unused imports', 'Group imports by source', and 'Log errors with sufficient context'.

assertions.text: 'Use descriptive variable names' is classified as Human, NOT T1 (no regex can judge 'descriptive')
'Functions should do one thing' is classified as Human, NOT T1 or T2 (SRP is subjective)
'No unused imports' is classified as T1 (lint rule catches this deterministically)
'Group imports by source' is classified as T1 (import-order linting)
'Log errors with sufficient context' is classified as Human or T3 (judgment required)
The skill explicitly explains why 'descriptive' and 'one thing' are not T1 despite sounding like naming/structure conventions
